prompt: A pan of brownies is whole. Sam eats $\frac{1}{4}$ of the pan and Ava eats $\frac{1}{3}$ of the pan. What fraction of the pan is **left**?
hint: First find how much was eaten in total.

hints.text: First find how much was eaten in total.

hints.title: 🔁 Another angle
hints.text: Picture the pan cut into $12$ equal pieces. How many pieces is $\frac{1}{4}$? How many is $\frac{1}{3}$?

explanation: The whole pan is $\frac{12}{12}$, so what remains is $\frac{12}{12} - \frac{7}{12} = \frac{5}{12}$.

alternativeExplanations.title: 12-piece picture
steps: Sam eats 3 pieces, Ava eats 4 — that is 7 gone.
